description: NearIR Scout is a solo virtual team at the San Jose, California NASA Space Apps 2026 event. We are building a public web tool that lets anyone type a sky position and blink SPHEREx visits of that patch in time order, so motion and variability are easier to see. The first tests are the challenge targets: Barnard's Star, Epsilon Indi B, WISE 0855, RW Aurigae, and R Draconis. The team page and project use no personal photographs.
